missing: Independent testing of 16-bay chargers: real charge current per slot, whether the unit can run all 16 bays at once, accuracy of charge termination, heat, and long-term reliability. why: No major reviewer or authority covers 16-bay chargers. The only sources that answer the question are maker and retailer listings with spec claims. The roundups cover 4-8 bay models or are unverified affiliate content.
